steps.content: The phantom blocking your way is finally gone. You run as fast as your legs can carry you toward the disappearing scholar.
You reach out, but your hand catches nothing. The scholar is gone. Nothing is left behind but a puddle of mud on the ground.
With her gone, the illusory realm starts bending this way and that. Red light splashes down onto the ground, melting away everything it touches like a corrosive acid.

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voices
steps.content: Human beings are as insignificant as specks of dust. You're trapped for eternity in this tiny planet of yours. You look up at the night sky and see millions of shining stars. They are but a drop in the ocean that is the universe.

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voices
steps.content: You're a feeble-minded species. The knowledge you've gleaned over hundreds of generations is negligible. Even if you were in the presence of the ultimate truth, all you could do is scratch your head in confusion. You tilt at windmills, you fight losing battles. As for her, she is the embodiment of the stupidity of your kind.

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voices
steps.content: But the ultimate truth admires her quixotic efforts. She treats all creatures equally. She'll accept anyone with open arms, as long as they're willing to admit their inferiority and become part of something greater.

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voices
steps.content: **** has made her choice. She has chosen to become part of the ultimate truth, part of me.
You dig in the mud in a frenzy, hoping against hope that you can find something she left behind. You need her to give you directions. You need to get back to the stele. You have a place to return to.
And you want to take her with you.

steps.speaker: Vague Voice
steps.content: It's too late. You don't belong here. You can't take anyone away from here.
Dark descends. When you're about to lose consciousness, you hear a voice.
You want to call out her name, but can't remember what her name is. Your hand, still submerged in the mud, feels warm. And then you see dots of blue light through the mud.
Pieces of crystal come out of the mud. They grow, expand. And they blossom. Before long, light blue crystal flowers are everywhere. They give out a gentle, soothing light.
A warm current runs through your body. And vaguely, you hear a familiar voice.

steps.speaker: Feeble Voice
steps.content: Go back where you came from, my dear guide...

steps.speaker: Feeble Voice
steps.content: I hope... you can find your way back...
